subject: Request: Oakmont encryption & HSM handoff — onboarding evidence and demo
messages:
From: Ellen Park <security@oakmontbank.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Encryption evidence for SOC2 onboarding — request and timelines

Marcus / Redwood team,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Oakmont's SOC2 intake team needs a compact evidence package for our security review and SIG/CAIQ alignment. We're focusing on encryption and key management components. To move forward we need the following by EOD next Thursday (2028-04-26):

- HSM/KMS ownership and operator matrix (who has console/KMS permissions).
- HSM attestation summary (firmware/attestation statement) and any vendor-signed seals you can share.
- Key rotation ledger for the last 12 months: policy, rotation events, and operator IDs (redact operator PII if needed).
- Sample KMS access audit (searchable CSV or query result) with timestamps, which we'll use to validate least-privilege controls.
- A short plan/description for BYOK handoff (if customer-managed keys are required) and any recommended handshake steps.

Please place files in the shared Drive folder we discussed (link below) or send a secure upload. Also let us know if a short live walkthrough (30–45m) of the HSM handoff and rotation logs is possible next week — our audit team prefers live demos to supplement artifacts.

Link: https://oakmontbank.sharepoint.com/sites/infosec/Oakmont-Redwood

Best,
Ellen Park
Senior InfoSec Manager
Oakmont Bank
[attachment: None]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <security@oakmontbank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Encryption evidence for SOC2 onboarding — request and timelines

Ellen — thanks, we can do that. High-level response and delivery plan below, and I've attached a template we will populate.

Summary of what we'll deliver by 2028-04-26: 
1) Operator & access matrix (CSV + narrative) — who has KMS/HSM operator roles, scoped to your requested tenancy.
2) HSM attestation summary — vendor attestation (redacted where necessary) and our verification checklist.
3) Key rotation ledger — rotation events for root/tenant keys for the last 12 months plus the rotation policy excerpt.
4) KMS access audit sample — query export (CSV) showing principal, action, timestamp, resource; we will redact personal emails per your guidance but keep operator IDs consistent.
5) BYOK handoff playbook — step-by-step with expected evidence artifacts and a recommended demo checklist.

Attachments: oakmont_handover_template.pdf (attached) — includes a sample handoff checklist and required artifacts.

Scheduling: we can run the 30–45m walkthrough on Tue 2028-04-25 or Wed 2028-04-26 between 09:00–13:00 PT. Which window works for your audit team?

Operational notes / constraints:
- For HSM attestation we can provide vendor-signed statements and a snapshot of the device manifest. Production HSM forensic logs contain sensitive operator identifiers; we'll provide a redacted extract tailored for audit.
- Rotation ledger: we keep an append-only ledger that we can export as a CSV; the exported file will include rotation_event_id, key_id (internal), previous_key_hash, new_key_hash, rotation_timestamp, initiator_id.

I'll ask Laura to provide the CSV sample and Rishi to confirm the attestation artifacts. Olga will coordinate the Drive upload and DocuSign envelope if needed for BYOK acknowledgements.

Marcus Lin
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[attachment: oakmont_handover_template.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Ellen Park <security@oakmontbank.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-20T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Encryption evidence for SOC2 onboarding — request and timelines

Ellen, Marcus —

Quick note with concrete formats and a small sample attached. We're preparing the rotation ledger export as CSV and the access audit sample using the following column set:

rotation_event_id, key_id, key_alias, previous_key_hash, new_key_hash, rotation_timestamp, initiator_id, rotation_reason

Sample row (redacted initiator_id):
RE-2027-11-03-001, k-root-0001, root-key, 3f6a1b2c..., 9a8d7c6e..., 2027-11-03T02:15:10Z, op-XXXX, scheduled_annual_rotation

Access audit sample columns: timestamp, principal_id, principal_type, action, resource, request_ip, request_user_agent, result
Sample row: 2028-02-11T14:07:22Z, op-XXXX, operator, kms:GenerateDataKey, arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:acct:key/k-abc123, 18.205.40.12, aws-sdk-nodejs/2.0.0, Success

Notes on PII: we will keep operator IDs consistent (op-XXXX) across artifacts so you can correlate actions to rotation events without exposing PII. If Oakmont needs actual names for legal reasons we can provide a separate signed mapping via secure mailbox after an NDA/POC statement.

Attached: kms-rotation-log-sample.csv (contains 3 sample rotations and 5 audit rows). We'll anonymize and compress before upload.

Ask: Ellen — do you prefer the artifacts uploaded to the Drive folder you mentioned or are we to use the Redwood secure intake (link included in template)? If Drive is preferred, Olga will place the files and share the folder ACLs set to recipients only.

Laura Bennett
Senior Security Engineer, RedTeam
Redwood Inference
[attachment: kms-rotation-log-sample.csv (text/csv)]

From: Tom Hsu <audit-team@grayshield.com>
To: Ellen Park <security@oakmontbank.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-21T16:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Encryption evidence for SOC2 onboarding — request and timelines

Thanks Ellen / Marcus — GrayShield can accept the artifacts as described. A couple of small items before the walkthrough: 

- Please ensure the rotation ledger includes checksum/hash values for previous and new keys (helps verify continuity).
- For the demo, we prefer to see (a) the KMS audit console filtered to a single rotation event and (b) a short replay of the event correlation between the audit log and the rotation ledger (10–15m).

We're available for the walkthrough on Tue 2028-04-25 at 10:00 PT. If that works for Oakmont, we will issue a short pre-demo checklist to Marcus's team (expected artifacts + ephemeral credentials).

Tom Hsu
Lead Auditor, GrayShield Security (third-party)
[attachment: None]
